analysis_status: completed and frozen 2026-09-02; canonical bytes are inventoried by outputs/cacie_v1.1_release_manifest.json

tracking.provenance_authority: upstream manifest top-level tracking_method and parameters written by the track-producing stage

source_quality_exclusions.policy: num_points / median(num_points in the available preceding and following 3 source rows) < 0.6; boundary frames use only available neighbors
source_quality_exclusions.primary_analysis: exclude all listed frames before sampling or aggregation
source_quality_exclusions.sensitivity_analysis: repeat full-record aggregate with partial frames included

ground_plane.coordinate_frame: canonical aligned trajectory frame used by tracks.parquet

occlusion.sparse_visibility_rule: at least 3 of 15 target-hitting rays are clear
occlusion.reference: analytic ray-upright-OBB intersection on a projected angular grid
occlusion.reference_scope_guardrail: within the dynamic oriented-box abstraction; not physical visibility ground truth

threshold_calibration.scope: ground_anchored covered decisions pooled across 120 and 360 degree FOVs
threshold_calibration.split: deterministic stratification by time decile and frame-density quartile
threshold_calibration.selection_objective: maximize covered-decision accuracy; break ties by absolute visibility-rate bias and then the larger threshold

validation.convergence_sample_relationship: deterministic 25-frame subset of the 200 main validation frames; not an independent sample

bootstrap.estimand: ratio of summed visible counts to summed target counts

decision_layer.primary_output: bootstrap-stable residual-demand ranking over ego-grid positions
decision_layer.finite_candidate_coverage_status: illustrative only; no surveyed poles or static-scene mesh

historical_full_record_entrypoint.current_difference_scope: completion-marker invalidation only; numerical algorithms are unchanged
